name: ActiveMQ
description: The ActiveMQ app is a unified logs and metrics app that helps you monitor the availability, performance, health, and resource utilization of your ActiveMQ messaging clusters. Preconfigured dashboards provide insight into cluster status, nodes, producers, consumers, destinations, resource utilization, message rates, and error logs.

children.name: ActiveMQ - Overview
children.description: The ActiveMQ - Overview dashboard gives you an at-a-glance view of your ActiveMQ deployment across brokers, queues, topics, and messages.
children.title: ActiveMQ - Overview

queries.queryString: messaging_cluster=* messaging_cluster={{messaging_cluster}} metric=activemq_broker_TotalConsumerCount | avg by messaging_cluster| sum
messaging_cluster=* messaging_cluster={{messaging_cluster}} metric=activemq_broker_TotalProducerCount | avg by messaging_cluster | sum
messaging_cluster=* messaging_cluster={{messaging_cluster}} metric=activemq_broker_TotalConnectionsCount | avg by messaging_cluster| sum
messaging_cluster=* messaging_cluster={{messaging_cluster}} metric=activemq_* destinationName=* | count by destinationName | count
messaging_cluster=* messaging_cluster={{messaging_cluster}} metric=activemq_broker_TotalEnqueueCount| rate | avg by messaging_cluster
messaging_cluster=* messaging_cluster={{messaging_cluster}} metric=activemq_broker_TotalDequeueCount| rate|avg by messaging_cluster
messaging_cluster=* messaging_cluster={{messaging_cluster}} metric=activemq_*_QueueSize|avg by messaging_cluster| sum
messaging_cluster=* messaging_cluster={{messaging_cluster}} metric=activemq_jvm_memory_HeapMemoryUsage_used| avg by messaging_cluster
messaging_cluster=* messaging_cluster={{messaging_cluster}} metric=activemq_jvm_memory_HeapMemoryUsage_max| avg by messaging_cluster
(#A/#B)*100 along messaging_cluster
messaging_cluster=* messaging_cluster={{messaging_cluster}} metric=activemq_OperatingSystem_SystemCpuLoad | avg by messaging_cluster | eval (_value *100)

messaging_system="activemq" messaging_cluster={{messaging_cluster}} ("error" or "ERROR" or "Error") 
| json "log" as _rawlog nodrop
| if(isEmpty(_rawlog),_raw,_rawlog) as _raw
| parse "*|*|*" as datetime,severity,msg
|count as count by datetime,severity,msg
| fields datetime,msg
| limit 10
messaging_cluster=* messaging_cluster={{messaging_cluster}} metric=activemq_jvm_runtime_Uptime |  quantize to 5m using count | count
messaging_cluster=* messaging_cluster={{messaging_cluster}} metric=activemq_jvm_runtime_Uptime | eval _value/3600000| avg by host

children.name: ActiveMQ - Logs
children.description: This dashboard helps you quickly analyze your ActiveMQ error logs across all clusters.
children.title: ActiveMQ - Logs

queries.queryString:
messaging_cluster=* messaging_system="activemq" messaging_cluster={{messaging_cluster}} (_sourceHost={{host}} or pod={{host}}) 
| json "log" as _rawlog nodrop
| if(isEmpty(_rawlog),_raw,_rawlog) as _raw
| parse "*|*|*|*|*" as timedate,severity,msg,class,address |trim(severity) as severity | count by severity

messaging_cluster=* messaging_system="activemq" messaging_cluster={{messaging_cluster}} (_sourceHost={{host}} or pod={{host}}) ("ERROR" or "Could not accept connection")
| json "log" as _rawlog nodrop
| if(isEmpty(_rawlog),_raw,_rawlog) as _raw
| parse "*|*|*|*|*" as timedate,severity,msg,class,address |trim(severity) as severity 
| timeslice 15m
| count as count by _timeslice
| fillmissing timeslice(15m)

messaging_cluster=* messaging_system="activemq" messaging_cluster={{messaging_cluster}} (_sourceHost={{host}} or pod={{host}}) ("ERROR" or "Could not accept connection")
| json "log" as _rawlog nodrop
| if(isEmpty(_rawlog),_raw,_rawlog) as _raw
| parse "*|*|*|*|*" as timedate,severity,msg,class,address |trim(severity) as severity | count as count by severity,msg | sort by count | limit 10

messaging_cluster=* messaging_system="activemq" messaging_cluster={{messaging_cluster}} (_sourceHost={{host}} or pod={{host}}) ("ERROR" or "WARN")
| json "log" as _rawlog nodrop
| if(isEmpty(_rawlog),_raw,_rawlog) as _raw
| parse "*|*|*|*|*" as timedate,severity,msg,class,address |trim(severity) as severity | count as count by severity,msg,timedate | sort by count,timedate | limit 10 | fields timedate,severity,msg

messaging_cluster=* messaging_system="activemq" messaging_cluster={{messaging_cluster}} (_sourceHost={{host}} or pod={{host}}) "shutdown" "Apache ActiveMQ"
| json "log" as _rawlog nodrop
| if(isEmpty(_rawlog),_raw,_rawlog) as _raw
| parse "*|*|*|*|*" as timedate,severity,msg,class,address  | count as count by timedate,msg | sort by timedate | fields timedate,msg

messaging_cluster=* messaging_system="activemq" messaging_cluster={{messaging_cluster}} (_sourceHost={{host}} or pod={{host}}) "started" "Apache ActiveMQ"
| json "log" as _rawlog nodrop
| if(isEmpty(_rawlog),_raw,_rawlog) as _raw
| parse "*|*|*|*|*" as timedate,severity,msg,class,address | count as count by timedate,msg | sort by timedate | fields timedate,msg

messaging_cluster=* messaging_system="activemq" messaging_cluster={{messaging_cluster}} (_sourceHost={{host}} or pod={{host}}) 
| json "log" as _rawlog nodrop
| if(isEmpty(_rawlog),_raw,_rawlog) as _raw
| parse "*|*|*|*|*" as timedate,severity,msg,class,address |limit 25 | trim(severity) as severity |count as count by timedate,msg,severity | sort by timedate |  fields timedate,severity,msg

messaging_cluster=* messaging_system="activemq" messaging_cluster={{messaging_cluster}} (_sourceHost={{host}} or pod={{host}}) 
| json "log" as _rawlog nodrop
| if(isEmpty(_rawlog),_raw,_rawlog) as _raw
| parse "*|*|*|*|*" as timedate,severity,msg,class,address  | trim(severity) as severity | limit 10000|logreduce by msg | _count as count | sort by count
| fields msg, signature, count

children.name: ActiveMQ - Resource Utilization
children.description:
The ActiveMQ - Resource Utilization dashboard provides an at-a-glance view of the state of system loads in clusters: CPU usage, memory usage, Swap usage,  file descriptor usage, garbage collection rate, heap, and non-heap usage.
Use this dashboard to: Analyze memory, CPU, disk, swap, file descriptor utilization of nodes in clusters . Gain insights into the garbage collection rate for your ActiveMQ nodes. Gain insights into heap, non-heap usage for your 
 ActiveMQ nodes.
children.title: ActiveMQ - Resource Utilization
